narrative.intro: Kiewit Infrastructure South has $387M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company has three awards so far, with an average award size of $129M. Obligations are concentrated in FY26 only, with prior fiscal years showing no recorded obligations. The Department of Agriculture is the largest buying agency, accounting for $261M. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration follows with $90.3M, and the Department of Defense accounts for $36M. Market activity centers on construction-related NAICS: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $297M, and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $90.3M. The page focuses on contract obligations, while the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values. Current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date. This picture shows a firm with concentrated, high-value awards in infrastructure and power markets, and with major buying agencies in Agriculture, NASA, and Defense.

sections.heading: Who are the top federal buyers for Kiewit Infrastructure South?
sections.body: The Department of Agriculture is the top buyer, providing $261M in obligations. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration provided $90.3M. The Department of Defense provided $36M.

sections.heading: What markets and award sizes dominate Kiewit Infrastructure South activity?

faq.q: How much does Kiewit Infrastructure South make from federal contracts?

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Kiewit Infrastructure South?
faq.a: The Department of Agriculture, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, and the Department of Defense are the top buyers. The Department of Agriculture provided $261M, NASA provided $90.3M, and the Department of Defense provided $36M.

faq.q: What does Kiewit Infrastructure South sell to the government?
faq.a: Kiewit Infrastructure South sells construction-related services to the government. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $297M and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $90.3M.
